title: The new manager and the old printer
instructionsRu: Перепиши фразу тремя способами, сохранив смысл. В каждом варианте используй указанную конструкцию.
material: The new manager repaired the old printer yesterday, so we can finally print our reports.

examples: the old printer was repaired yesterday
the printer has been fixed by the new manager

items.text: Условное 2-го типа (если бы менеджер не починил…)

examples: if the manager didn't repair the printer, we couldn't print
we wouldn't print our reports if he hadn't fixed it
a colleague said that the new manager had repaired the printer
she told me we could finally print
